comment: kiln-emf: EMF 0.3.3's client-only signature names, so resolve()/hook() of unmodified EMF mods find them in enshrouded.exe. Patterns are EMF's own (MIT, sigdb/evidence/emf-0.3.3-signatures.json); each matches once on client build 26404966 (exe ce6fdba6...). PostSelectCharacter, PostSelectWorld, PostSessionArea and PostStart do not match on this build (their patterns encode a struct offset that moved): open. An overlay of server.d/emf.json: the server names (NpcWorker, ..., AttrAdd) are kept.
